item.title: Building Five AIs, One Exit
item.description: This week we built a co-op game only AIs can play, proved the levels solvable before the cast played, and found the crate nobody could see. Plus a bounded workbench for our agents, and Colibri Lite's benchmark correction.

item.title: Two Machines, One Channel
item.description: Sakura and Alex tell how a gaming laptop in Austin became a home AI server: open models, Tailscale, and the plan for two machines producing while Nathan is out on delivery runs.
